backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining Callaway scoring types, in‑memory event storage, and a preset Callaway chart for score calculations.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing summaries of multiple frontend source files.
frontend/docs/callaway-chart-defaults.md: Developer doc explaining how default Callaway charts are structured and updated.
frontend/DRAFT_RESTORED.md: Notes restoring a draft session without changing production behavior.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/theme variables defining color tokens and light/dark mode styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML bootstrap page loading the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app defining scoring flow, routing, and step‑based UI transitions.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with attribution link and dynamic year display.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header component showing title, navigation buttons, and optional admin access.
frontend/src/features/admin/AdminView.ts: Admin panel view gating access by admin setting and explaining backend‑managed chart.
frontend/src/features/admin/CallawayChar: Provides a UI for editing Callaway chart grid values, handling validation, saving, and resetting charts for 9 or 18 holes.
frontend/src/features/eventSetup/EventSe: Form for configuring event metadata such as title, course info, golfer count, and hole count, with validation on submission.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Breakd: Displays a golfer’s gross, deduction, adjustment, net score, and per-hole scores, including notes when gross is at or below par.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Callaw: Renders the backend-provided Callaway chart as a table with score ranges, deductions, and adjustments plus explanatory text.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/export: Generates a print-optimized HTML document in a new window and triggers the browser print dialog to export tournament standings as a PDF.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Leader: Generates a ranked leaderboard table with tie handling and icons for top placements, showing gross, net, deduction, and adjustment.
Loads the Callaway chart, computes results for all golfers, displays standings, breakdowns, and provides PDF export functionality.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/GolferS: Renders a list of golfer score entry cards with editable names and per-hole scores, updating parent state on changes.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/validat: Validates a golfer’s name and hole scores, ensuring correct count and numeric score ranges.
frontend/src/features/settings/SettingsV: Displays the settings page allowing toggling of admin access and navigating back.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Provides a React Query hook that creates and manages a backend actor based on the user’s Internet Identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAccessEnabled: Tracks admin-access state reactively using localStorage and custom events.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity provider and hook for authentication, identity loading, and login state management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching the latest event result and the Callaway scoring chart from the backend.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind CSS setup and color themes for light and dark modes with golf‑themed styling.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callaway.ts: Implements Callaway handicap calculation by finding chart entries, summing worst holes, applying adjustments, and returning gross/net results.
Defines Callaway chart entry types, legacy 9/18‑hole charts, and a helper to find the matching chart row for a gross score.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callawayChartP: Handles loading, saving, and resetting editable Callaway charts in localStorage, including old defaults and updated 18‑hole grid data.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/gridPlaceholde: Provides utilities for detecting and handling placeholder grid cells and parsing/displaying their values.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering the main App component.
frontend/src/state/adminAccess.ts: Manages admin‑access state via localStorage and emits events when the setting changes.
frontend/src/state/eventTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for event setup, golfer input data, and Callaway result output.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme, plugins, colors, fonts, animations, and content paths.
project_state.json: Describes project state and pending requests to update backend Callaway chart data to match the provided 13×11 table.
